title: Punjab Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2003

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT
PUNJAB LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(FIRST AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2003
ACT IV OF 2003
An Act further to
amend the
Punjab Local
Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
10th February, 2003]
No.PAP-Legis-2(4)/2003/430,
dated 10-2-2003.--The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Bill, 2003,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 8th February.
2003, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 10th February 2003, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Punjab Local Government
(First Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from 31st December, 2002.

No.PAP-Legis-2(4)/2003/430,
dated 10-2-2003.--The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Bill, 2003,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 8th February.
2003, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 10th February 2003, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment in section 24 of
Ordinance XIII of 2001.--In the said Ordinance, in the proviso of
subsection (8) of section 24, the figures, word and comma "31st December,
2002" shall be substituted by the figures, word and comma "30th June,
2003".
